summary: A seat that is compacting its conversation shows as compacting (agent activity), not as working or stuck and never as an alert, for Claude Code, Codex and omp (#1934)

replay.detail: No replay. The status derives from the harness reason the drivers already publish.

schema.detail: No database change. The client schema's Agent gains optional activity; the contract digest changes.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: Additive optional Agent.activity ('compacting'); older clients ignore it. The Claude driver now records reason compaction at PreCompact, and the omp channel from its pre_compact frame to its compaction context frame; pi reports only the end and shows no status. Codex already reported reason compaction. st agents ls (enriched) prints the activity line.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; seats pick up the driver change on their next start.

recovery.detail: Swap back freely; an older daemon omits activity.
